title: Facebook — Beechjet 400A capability without the bill
body:
Not every mission needs a big jet — and not every budget wants one. This 2002 Beechjet 400A is the sweet spot: fresh 2022 paint and interior, Pro Line 4 avionics, Gogo AVANCE L3 Wi-Fi to keep the cabin connected, and thrust reversers for shorter, safer stops.

Around 6,870 hours total, presenting like a much newer airplane. A clean, honest light jet for an owner who wants real capability without the operating cost of a larger cabin.

Full maintenance summary available on request.
